_comment: WingtipToys regression scenario. NOT a parity scenario: the snapshot beside it is recorded from the CONVERTED app, so it says nothing about matching the original. It catches unintended DOM changes from converter work - see corpora/regression-gate.ps1.

steps._why: With a ProductID, because the application forbids the other form: AddToCart.aspx.cs says 'it is illegal to load AddToCart.aspx without setting a ProductId' and calls Debug.Fail, which terminates the process in a Debug build. The step used to have no query string and recorded an empty page - the page was never reaching Page_Load at all.
